Bengaluru Flood Map
Flood Reporting Tool
Community-powered flood mapping for Bengaluru

Welcome to the Bengaluru Flood Map. This platform allows people to report locations across Bangalore where flooding has occurred. The website is intended as a data collection and documentation tool to help build a better understanding of flood patterns across the city. User submissions will contribute to identifying affected areas and supporting future analysis and planning.
